name: boundary_buffer_m
reason: A record this close outside its own community boundary still counts as a match (tanks at airstrips / barge landings). 61 records match only via the buffer; none is a known error.

name: boundary_review_km
reason: A mismatch farther than this from its own boundary is 'review'; nearer is 'low' (neighbouring place). Catches 72 of 74 known errors with 121 flags (10 km: 140 flags, same catch).

name: typo_match_km
reason: A one-digit coordinate edit landing this close to the label's cluster is a typo candidate. The 3 confirmed typos land < 1 km; the 4 false positives matched at 4-8 km.

name: shared_point_m
reason: Coordinates equal within this are the same point. The 51 stacked records share points to the metre.

name: dedup_tol_m
reason: Rows closer than this merge into one site. 32 cross-community merges at 50 m vs 23 at 1 m: the cannot-link rule (plan phase 5) matters more than the distance.

name: label_spread_km
reason: A record this far from its label's main cluster is reported as information only (mostly remote sites with a home-town label).
